lines.zh: 我在水面上翻了个身，往前划。
lines.en: I roll onto my back and paddle forward.

lines.zh: 在陆地上，我走得像条虫子。
lines.en: On land I crawl like a worm.
The water is my road.

lines.zh: 我用后脚蹬，尾巴带方向。
lines.en: I kick with my hind feet and steer with my tail.
I swim along the shallows.

lines.zh: 浪把我推了一下，我又游回来。
lines.en: A wave shoves me and I paddle back.
Two lines of prints mark the sand.
I slide along on my belly.
I know this patch of kelp.
I come ashore only to dry off.
I float on my back, belly up.
I rub my face with my paws.
This stone is my spot.
When the water cools, I tuck in.

lines.zh: 整群都在岸上，我在这边。
lines.en: The group is ashore. I am over here.
I do a head count. All present.
Kelp is wound around my paw.
I lift my nose and read the wind.
There is fish on that side.
I stare at the water and drift.

lines.zh: 我的毛一湿，就贴在身上。
lines.en: My fur clings when wet.
The head of the group is over there. I stay.

lines.zh: 偶尔白毛的同类会出现。
lines.en: Sometimes one of us is born white.
The sun makes me squint.
I curl myself up.
The water here is shallow.

lines.zh: 你下水，我看看你要干什么。
lines.en: Come into the water and let me see.
You are on the bank. I float here.
You look clumsy in the water.
I float on the surface, head tilted at you.
There is sand on your boots.
Do you want me, or the fish?

lines.zh: 这海是我的家，你是客人。
lines.en: This sea is my home. You are a guest.
I know your scent now.
Do not step on that stone.
Shall I share a fish? No.
You are standing too near the waterline.
I am watching your hands.
Why are you smiling? Am I funny?
The water is warm. Do not come in.
I curl up. That hurts.
I duck into the water.
I pant, eyes still open.
Wet fur makes it colder.
Who hit me? I will call the group.
I retreat and keep watching.
If I can still swim, it is not grave.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的同伴会围过来。
lines.en: Stop — my companions will close in.
Is that fish? Hand it over.

lines.zh: 我会用石头敲开壳，你信吗。
lines.en: I crack shells on stones. Believe it?
I will take it. Do not drop it in.
I will eat at your feet.
Did you catch or net this?
Done. I wipe my mouth.
Another and I will lie down.
That is very fresh.
My bump is soft.
Do not crowd. We will scatter.
I slip past your legs.

lines.zh: 在岸上，我本来就不灵活。
lines.en: On land I am clumsy to begin with.
You pushed me into the water.

lines.zh: 这下正好，我本来就想去水里。
lines.en: Fine. Into the water is where I was headed.
A patch of fur is ruffled.
The current pushed me away.
We struck only lightly.
I offer her a fish.
She does not take it, so I offer again.

lines.zh: 我们浮在一起，手拉着手。
lines.en: We float together, holding paws.
She bumps me with her nose.
This patch of kelp will do.
The head of the group is far off and does not mind.

lines.zh: 我们一同沉下去，又浮上来。
lines.en: We dive together, then rise.
Nothing shows on the surface.
This ease is only for my own.
At dark we drift side by side.
This stone will crack a shell.
I tuck it into the fold on my chest.
This is heavy. It will sink.
What I fish up is mine.
Not a shell. Not interesting.
I turn it over to see the underside.
I hold it under my arm.
I will trade it for fish.
One bite to test if it is hard.
That is not fish.
I look up your way.
There are pups in the group. I will not yield.
I put myself in front.
Leave the one in the water to me.
My teeth are not soft.
I wait for it to near the water.
This time I move first.

lines.zh: 叫声传出去，全群都知道。
lines.en: My call carries, and the group knows.
That one.
I do not run. I hold.
It is coming.
The smell of fish — let me get ready.
I know this water well.

lines.zh: 在我家的水里，你占不了便宜。
lines.en: You gain nothing in my home water.
I circle to the flank.
I watch from the water.
When you come near, the group scatters.
I do not call. I wait.
The water shields me.
I go under and past.
My fur makes no sound underwater.
You cannot find me.
The pups are behind me.
You are slow in the water.
This is my deep water.
The way out is there. Go.

lines.zh: 我数到水下第三次换气。
lines.en: I count three dives.
That is the third dive.
You are still here.
Then do not blame me.
I come from behind.
I bite into its fin.
My claws rake the gill.
In the water I am the more agile.
It thrashes hard.
I change my grip.
Water sprays high.
That was for the pups.
I only hold this patch.
I pin it in the shallows.
Claws first, then teeth.

lines.zh: 这一口咬得浅，还得再来。
lines.en: That bite went shallow. I need another.
It escapes onto land, and I stop.

lines.zh: 首领先上岸，我跟在后面。
lines.en: The leader beaches first; I follow after.
This sea is just cold enough.
I float and look around first.
Plenty of fish here.
I rub my face.
Stones on the bank, good for sunning.
The sea is calm. I call out first.
The water is clear to the bottom.
I find a spot out of the surf.
This is a new coast.
I drift further in.
Enough kelp here to wrap myself in.
I lift my head above the surface.

lines.zh: 冷空气一吹，我抖了一下。
lines.en: The cold air makes me shiver.
This could feed a whole group.
I smell the salt on the rocks.
First, a rock to lean on.
I roll over and float on my back.
Surf sounds in the distance.
This is my good spot for today.
I hit the rocks and my ribs ache.
Water in my nose. I kick hard.
The blast throws up water and flips me.
A barb sticks in my back.

lines.zh: 这力量让我的爪子发麻。
lines.en: This force numbs my paws.
Two days empty and I cannot swim well.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我整只僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，我一直往下坠。
lines.en: No water below. I keep falling.
